outgoing.name: Rudyard Kipling
outgoing.excerpt: Danny Deever is an 1890 poem by Rudyard Kipling, one of the first of the Barrack-Room Ballads.

outgoing.name: William Butler Yeats
outgoing.excerpt: It was later commented on by William Butler Yeats, who noted that "[Kipling] interests a critical audience today by the grotesque tragedy of Danny Deever".
